# P3-07 — Containers and deploy-as-code

Branch `build/w1-platform`. Lane notes: `docs/build/lanes/W1-platform.md` (P3-07 section). Operator doc: `docs/qcompass/deployment.md`.

## What was done
- **Images** (`docker/Dockerfile.cpu`, `docker/Dockerfile.cuda12`). Each file has two targets: `api` gives `qcompass-api` and `worker` gives `qcompass-worker` (cpu; the gpu variant comes from the CUDA file). Pins:
  - CPU base: Python 3.12.15 `slim-bookworm` by digest.
  - CUDA base: CUDA 12.6.3 cuDNN on Ubuntu 24.04 by digest, with uv-managed CPython 3.12.13.
  - uv: 0.11.32 by digest.
  - Dependencies: `uv sync --frozen` from `uv.lock`.

  Both images run as non-root uid 10001, have a `/healthz` HEALTHCHECK, carry OCI labels, set `QCOMPASS_ENV=production`, ship no compilers and never enable dev anonymous access. The image includes `supabase/migrations`, so it can migrate a database itself.
- **Worker `/healthz`** (`ucgle_f1.worker.serve_health`, on `$PORT`): 200 while the loop turns or a job runs, 503 when the loop has stalled or is stopping.
- **`deploy/`**: Cloud Run services `qcompass-api`, `qcompass-worker-cpu` (min 1, CPU always allocated, internal ingress) and `qcompass-worker-gpu` (L4, min `${GPU_MIN_INSTANCES}` defaulting to 0). Secrets come only from Secret Manager references. `deploy/web/{staging,production}.env` holds the frontend flags per environment.
- **`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`**:
  - Staging deploys on push to `main`. Production deploys on `qcompass-v*` tags, from `release-please.yml`, or by manual dispatch.
  - Jobs use the GitHub environments `staging` and `production`.
  - Auth is Workload Identity Federation (`google-github-actions/auth@7c6bc770…` v3.0.0, `setup-gcloud@aa5489c8…` v3.0.1, both pinned by SHA).
  - Images are built and pushed to Artifact Registry, then deployed with `gcloud run services replace`.
  - The Cloudflare Worker deploy builds with `VITE_API_URL` set to that environment's API URL.
  - Every job checks its secrets first. Where any are missing it writes `BLOCKED-ON-JAMES:<names>` to the step summary and exits 0. It also checks that the registry repo and the Secret Manager entries exist, and never creates them.
- **CI `images` job** (`ci.yml`) builds and smoke-tests the images: `docker build --check` on both Dockerfiles, build of both CPU images, then `scripts/container_smoke.sh` against a `postgres:16.4` service.

## Done-when proof (local run of exactly what CI runs)
Docker 29.9.2 in the sandbox. The only difference from CI is the build arg `PYTHON_IMAGE=<pinned base + the sandbox proxy CA>`, which the sandbox needs to reach PyPI and which is never committed. Postgres was `postgres:16.4`.

`DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:55432/postgres scripts/container_smoke.sh qcompass-api:local qcompass-worker:local` → exit 0:
```
qcompass-api:local: user 10001:10001, HEALTHCHECK /healthz, Python 3.12
qcompass-worker:local: user 10001:10001, HEALTHCHECK /healthz, Python 3.12
── 2. migrations from the api image   (11 applied)
── 3. api /healthz and /readyz
{"status":"ok"}
{"status":"ready","checks":{"database":{"ok":true,...},"storage":{"ok":true,...},"queue":{"ok":true,...}}}
   anonymous GET /api/qcompass/domains → 401 (production config)
── 4. worker starts and answers /healthz
{"status": "ok", "worker_id": "vm:1:…", "classes": ["cpu"], "busy": false}   + log "serving cpu"
── 5. a job through the api and worker containers
POST /api/qcompass/domains/chemistry/runs → 202
run qc_chemistry_dcd6d726346b completed in the worker container; classical_reference_hash=86838ca2…
container smoke: OK
```
`docker build --check` on both Dockerfiles → "Check complete, no warnings found."

The deploy jobs run only when the secrets exist. Otherwise they report `BLOCKED-ON-JAMES:GCP_PROJECT_ID,GCP_REGION,GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER,GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT` and `BLOCKED-ON-JAMES:CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN,CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID` and succeed. This was verified by reading the workflow and by `backend/tests/test_deploy_config.py`; the workflow itself first runs on GitHub (CI-PENDING).

## Tests
`backend/tests/test_deploy_config.py` (14 passed) checks the following:
- images: pinned by digest, exact Python patch, non-root, HEALTHCHECK in both stages, OCI labels, production environment, dependencies from the lock;
- services: Secret Manager references only, no dev flag, `QCOMPASS_ENV` from the workflow, `/healthz` probes;
- the workflow: Part 6 secret names, `BLOCKED-ON-JAMES` reporting, third-party actions pinned by SHA, `id-token: write`, environments staging/production only;
- dev anonymous access is impossible unless `QCOMPASS_ENV=dev` (6 cases);
- the worker's `/healthz` behaviour.

The full-suite results are the same final-tree runs listed in `P4-02.md`: backend fast suite 418 passed, packages 350 passed, the licence gate passes, and `uv lock --check` passes.

## Gaps
- The CUDA image is linted, not built, in CI and was not built here because of its size. It is first built by the deploy workflow (CI-PENDING).
- Cloud Run GPU workers scale to 0 by default. `gpu_*` jobs wait in the queue until `GPU_MIN_INSTANCES` is raised, because a Cloud Run service with no HTTP traffic does not scale up on its own.
- The deploy workflow and `release-please.yml` changes have not run on GitHub yet. They have no secrets, so they will report BLOCKED.
